dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Here's your new phone. Let's turn it on.
dialogue.reading: hɪrz jʊr ˈnuː ˈfoʊn. ˈlɛts ˈtɜːrn ɪt ˈɑːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. It's on! What do I do now?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ɪts ˈɑːn! ˈwʌt duː aɪ ˈduː ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Log in to the app with your email and your password.
dialogue.reading: ˌlɔːɡ ˈɪn tə ði ˈæp wɪð jʊr ˈiːmeɪl ənd jʊr ˈpæswɜːrd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then you need to sign up first. It's free.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn juː ˈniːd tə ˌsaɪn ˈʌp ˈfɜːrst. ɪts ˈfriː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. I signed up, and now I can log in!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. aɪ ˈsaɪnd ˈʌp, ənd ˈnaʊ aɪ kən ˌlɔːɡ ˈɪn!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great! And when you go to class, turn off your phone.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! ənd wɛn juː ˈɡoʊ tə ˈklæs, ˌtɜːrn ˈɔːf jʊr ˈfoʊn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good idea. Mr. Brown doesn't like phones in class!
dialogue.reading: ˌɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈdʌzənt ˈlaɪk ˈfoʊnz ɪn ˈklæs!
